## Construction and scope

Exact frames telescope with absolute phase and adjoint preserved. The signed invoice loses 34 rank-two and adds 17 rank-four positions across 17 calls. Paid total falls to 110,468, productive total is 22,461, ordinary work falls by 17,000, and the elementary tape upper bound falls by 2,898,976. The directed threshold is bounded by [0.00364841129479084532481164992024, 0.00364841129479084532481164992025].

[Same-pool screen and controls](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/blob/96e4a0dd34b98388d2911fd37df70c15e70840de/research/p104-role902-direct-lift/RANKING.md). Task scope is refined to this one literal pair on top of canonical main e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. The first two commits are the existing #7257 onboarding prerequisite, separately scoped and credited.

The [first hosted run](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43518471602/job/132208623551) passed independent and native checks, then hit the combined command’s cap. The package now separates native and signed command budgets and checks the same scientific receipt.
